from PIL import Image, ImageOps, ImageDraw
from pathlib import Path
paths=[Path('renders')/f'frame_{str(t).replace(\".\",\"_\")}.jpg' for t in [2,5,8,12,13.3,16.8,21.4,23.3,27.8,30.7,33.2,35.3,38,41.2,43.3,44.5]]

sheet.save('renders/contact_sheet.jpg',quality=90)
PY"
